name: Tulsidas
contribution: A Ramanandi Vaishnava Hindu saint, devotee, and poet renowned for his devotion to the deities Rama, Sita, and Hanuman.
legacy: He wrote several popular works in Sanskrit, Awadhi, and Braj Bhasha, but is best known as the author of the Hanuman Chalisa and of the epic Ramcharitmanas, a retelling of the Sanskrit Ramayana, based on Rama's life, in the vernacular Awadhi language.

checks.lead: Rambola Dubey (c. 1532 – c. 1623), popularly known as Goswami Tulsīdās, was a Ramanandi Vaishnava Hindu saint, devotee, and poet renowned for his devotion to the deities Rama, Sita, and Hanuman. He wrote several popular works in Sanskrit, Awadhi, and Braj Bhasha, but is best known as the author of the Hanuman Chalisa and of the epic Ramcharitmanas, a retelling of the Sanskrit Ramayana, based on Rama's life, in the vernacular Awadhi language.
